rows.note: Use 冠軍賽 as the all-purpose term for a competition held to decide the champion.

example.english: Tonight is the championship match between the two teams.
example.traditional: 今晚就係兩隊爭冠軍嘅冠軍賽。
example.jyutping: gam1 maan5 zau6 hai6 loeng5 deoi6 zaang1 gun1 gwan1 ge3 gun1 gwan1 coi3

rows.note: Use 冠軍 for the champion or the championship title someone holds, not the contest itself.

example.english: I’m really happy to win this championship.
example.traditional: 攞到呢個冠軍，我真係好開心。
example.jyutping: lo2 dou2 ni1 go3 gun1 gwan1 ngo5 zan1 hai6 hou2 hoi1 sam1

rows.note: Use 支持 when championship means backing or support for a cause rather than a sporting title or contest.

example.english: We’re really grateful for your continued championship of our environmental campaign.
example.traditional: 你一直支持我哋個環保計劃，我哋真係好感激。
example.jyutping: nei5 jat1 zik6 zi1 ci4 ngo5 dei6 go3 waan4 bou2 gai3 waak6 ngo5 dei6 zan1 hai6 hou2 gam2 gik1
